caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing figure placed on a rectangular base. The figure is dressed in a short skirt and a feathered headdress colored in red, yellow, and blue, with a prominent red feather at the top. The figure's upper body is bare, with defined arms and torso. The right arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand raised to the brow in a saluting gesture, while the left arm rests by the side. The figure also has long, black braided hair, and a red mantle draped over the left shoulder and hanging behind. The base is painted in a wood-toned brown color with visible grain, and the statue itself displays various shades of brown, tan, and muted earth tones to highlight different body parts and clothing. Minimal shading and a light background keep all attention on the figure.
title: Cigar Store Indian
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
